The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8d9bc135865dbc97), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 28. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: The categories W+ s (S) and W− −s(S) are dual, with the normalized pairing ⟨W, W′ ⟩ = ΓdR(W ⊗! W′ )[−2δN ]. (4.3) In a pole bound this formula uses the bounded-zero star-extension convention of Proposition 4.2. It then extends continuously to the full pole model. Equivalently, one may place one argument in a pole bound and !-restrict the other to that bound. The analogous pairing relative to S is defined by relative star image. Closed images transpose to !-restrictions. These statements hold for the Ran categories, formed as limits under !-restriction along the diagonals, and are compatible with tensoring a spectator category.
